drawing_notes.raw_text: COMPRESSOR UNIT CONTROL PANEL (UCP) BEING REPLACED UNDER THIS PROJECT. extracted_rule.subject: Compressor Unit Control Panel (UCP)
extracted_rule.rule: The Compressor Unit Control Panel (UCP) is to be replaced with a new PLC-based UCP. drawing_notes.raw_text: NEW SAFETY RELIEF VALVE SHALL BE PROVIDED TO SAFEGUARD SYSTEM AGAINST OVERPRESSURE (BLOCKED DISCHARGE CONDITION). ISOLATION VALVES SHALL BE PROVIDED WITH NEW PLATFORM FOR OPERATION.

extracted_rule.subject: Safety Relief Valve
extracted_rule.rule: A new safety relief valve must be installed to protect the system from overpressure due to a blocked discharge. New isolation valves and a new operating platform must also be provided.

drawing_notes.raw_text: COMMON WARE HOUSE SPARE RV SHALL BE PROVIDED (ONE NO. FOR 3 COMPRESSOR).
THERE IS NO INTERLOCKING FOR ISOLATION VALVE ON SINGLE RV.
NEW PROPOSED MOTOR ENCLOSURE (ATEX, EX'P' TYPE) REQUIRES INSTRUMENT AIR.
EXISTING RCI MODULE SHALL BE REMOVED FROM THE EXISTING UCP PANEL AND SHALL BE RE-USED INSIDE THE NEW UCP PANEL.
COMPRESSOR SUCTION ESD VALVE (V-ESDV-209) IS RETAINED.

ONE (COMMON FOR ALL THREE TRAINS) TEMPORARY SUCTION STRAINER SHALL BE SUPPLIED BY OEM (MS. HITACHI). AFTER SUCCESSFULL COMMISSIONING, THE STRAINER SHALL BE REMOVED, AND REPLACED WITH A FABRICATED SPOOL PIECE BY EPIC CONTRACTOR.

COMPRESSOR LOWER DESIGN TEMPERATURE (-)29 DEGC, EXCEPT FOR DRY GAS SEAL O-RING, WHICH IS 0 DEGC. COMPRESSOR UPPER DESIGN TEMPERATURE 150 DEGC, HOWEVER, SINCE ASME PTC10 TYPE 2 TEST SHALL BE CONDUCTED, THEREFORE, COMPRESSOR CASING SHALL BE DESIGNED TO 170 DEGC WHICH IS REQUIRED DUE TO THE USE OF CO2 AS TEST GAS. ULTIMATELY NAME PLATE RATING FOR THIS UNIT USING ETHANE GAS IS 150 DEGC.

HIGH PERFORMANCE (CLASS-1) NON-RETURN VALVE (NON-SLAM TYPE), WITH LOW CRACK OPEN DP SHALL BE SELECTED FOR THIS APPLICATION. (PURPOSE: AVOID REVERSE FLOW / SURGE ISSUES DURING DYNAMIC SCENARIO OF COMPRESSOR TRIP).
EXISTING SUCTION & DISCHARGE COMPRESSOR INLET & OUTLET SPOOL SHALL BE DISMANTLED TO FACILITATE COMPRESSOR MODIFICATION, AND THEN RE-INSTATED.
SOFT HAND SWITCH SHALL BE CONFIGURED IN UCP HMI TO ENABLE/ DISABLE STATION S HIGH PRESSURE CONTROLLER (%) WHICH IS REPEATED FROM LOAD SHARING PANEL.

RECLOSURE OF XV-202 (NORMAL SHUTDOWN DEPRESSURING VALVE) SHALL BE PERFORMED BY UCP, ONCE V-PAL-214 IS OBTAINED (@ 18 barg) OR AFTER 20 MINUTES TIME DELAY FROM OPENING OF XV-202 WHICHEVER COMES FIRST. (NOTE: PAL-214 SHALL BE CONSIDERED AN EVENT, NOT ALARM).
FOR INTERLOCK DETAILS, REFER TO SYMBOLS & LEGENDS DRAWING NO. 4224-MGDTY-6-50-2001-003.
